title: Citizen Complaint Response
promptText:
Draft an empathetic, formal response to a citizen complaint related to power transmission / right-of-way / service disruption under MahaTransco's remit (or redirect correctly if it belongs to a distribution company).

Complaint text:
[Paste citizen message]

Response requirements:
1. Acknowledge the inconvenience without admitting liability beyond facts given.
2. Clarify jurisdiction if the issue is likely DISCOM vs TRANSCO.
3. State what has been / will be checked (use process language; no fake ticket IDs).
4. Give realistic next-step expectations using placeholders for timelines.
5. Provide official channel guidance only — no personal mobile numbers.
6. Keep under 160 words; bilingual option: English body + Marathi summary paragraph.

Rules:
- Do not invent feeder names, compensation amounts, or fault causes.
- Mark unknowns as [VERIFY].
- Tone: respectful, calm, administratively precise.
